title: Jerry Junkman
body:
Description

Jerry Junkman was the former shopkeeper of the Jer's Junkyard Store.

After the map update, he now resides outside Lighthouse.

History

Before the map update there was a wanted poster for Jerry offering a Tall Refined Axe posted on the Oak Depot. It has been removed since the update.

If you dropped a neon cheese on top of him he would turn angelic and spawn a Tall Refined Axe. This is no longer working after the map update.
